themes.description: Users report frequent slow loading, freezing, and crashes especially when viewing charts or switching accounts, leading to poor trading experience.
themes.business_impact: Delays in chart rendering and app freezes cause users to miss market opportunities, directly reducing commission revenue and increasing churn for the platform.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The chart rendering engine is inefficient and tightly coupled with data fetching; combined with memory leaks and inadequate caching, it overconsumes CPU and RAM, triggering stalls and crashes.
themes.action_plan:
• Profile CPU/memory during chart load to identify hotspots
• Refactor chart rendering to use a lightweight, WebGL‑based library
• Implement lazy loading and data caching for historical candles
• Move data fetching to background threads and debounce UI updates
• Reduce unnecessary re‑renders when switching accounts or adding indicators
• Deploy a staged rollout with telemetry to monitor latency and crash rates
• Provide a lightweight placeholder UI during heavy loads
• Conduct regression QA and user testing before each release

themes.description: Users repeatedly report that the app lacks the ability to set trailing stop losses, stop‑loss, and target orders directly on the chart or within a single GTT order, hindering effective risk management during trades.
themes.business_impact: Without these risk‑management tools, traders are forced to exit positions manually or rely on external tools, increasing the probability of unplanned losses and reducing user satisfaction, which can lead to churn and negative word‑of‑mouth among active traders.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The feature backlog prioritizes interface polish over core trading functionality, and the current order‑execution API does not expose a unified GTT type that supports stop‑loss/target, causing developers to postpone implementation.
themes.action_plan:
• 1. Re‑prioritize trailing stop loss and stop‑loss/target feature into the next release sprint
• 2. Design a unified GTT order model supporting stop‑loss, target, and trailing stop loss
• 3. Implement chart overlay controls for setting these values with real‑time price feedback
• 4. Add validation and confirmation screens to prevent accidental orders
• 5. Conduct regression and integration testing on Android, iOS, and web platforms
• 6. Roll out feature with a phased release and collect telemetry to refine UX
